riceToPaddy.status: recorded only; NOT applied to any yield or cost row
riceToPaddy.formula: paddy_kg = rice_kg / 0.67 (raw rice). Example from the cited report: 149.25 kg paddy is equivalent to 100 kg rice at 67 per cent.
riceToPaddy.basis: Government of India out-turn ratio (OTR) for custom milling of paddy: 67 kg raw rice or 68 kg parboiled rice per 100 kg paddy. Origin: Gokak Committee 1994, re-based on Tariff Commission recommendations of September 2005.
caveats: It is a policy norm for procurement and custom milling, not a measured recovery for a given variety or mill.

Millers dispute it for some varieties (for example Punjab PR-126 reported at 62-64 per cent in press reports), and the cited audit reports test-milling above 72 per cent for MTU 7029. Treat as a default and let the farmer override.

It was not confirmed that DES applies 67 per cent when it publishes paddy "in terms of rice"; the DES and TN yields in this file are published as rice (milled) and the conversion used by the publisher is not stated in the retrieved pages. The cited report footnotes that Ministry of Agriculture paddy figures in its table use 67 per cent.
